objective: Record and independently inspect a bounded live retrieval from the public ZTF DR24 HATS Lightcurves catalog. Verify objectid lookup, epoch counts, raw schema, provenance, and payload hashes without changing scientific processing.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The DR24 Lightcurves catalog is an indexed HATS dataset and supports objectid lookups.
DR24 HMJD is heliocentric-based and must not be relabeled as geocentric MJD.
DR24 mag and clrcoeff are source-native values; color correction requires separate color and calibration evidence.
catflags is a bitmask. The raw view must preserve flagged epochs and show quality diagnostics separately.
OID values are partitioned by filter/field/quadrant; OID proximity or coordinate similarity alone does not establish astrophysical identity.

baseline.description: Source-backed acquisition evidence only. No model, feature schema, taxonomy, benchmark, threshold, v0.2.0 artifact, or release change.

coverage.before: The DR24 source path had deterministic contract tests but no retained live payload evidence for this bounded object set.
coverage.after: Four requested OIDs returned successfully from the objectid index; no missing OIDs were reported.

correctness.before: Catalog nepochs and retrieved epoch counts had not been compared in a retained source-backed report.
correctness.after: All four OID payload counts match catalog nepochs; total retrieved rows are 626.

reproducibility.before: No independent run comparison was recorded.
reproducibility.after: Two runs produced identical epoch CSV and summary JSON SHA-256 values. Downloaded artifact hashes were recomputed and matched the manifest.

scientific_validity.reason: Raw payload retrieval does not validate astrophysical identity, feature compatibility, classifier performance, calibration, OOD, or anomaly detection.

reliability.reason: This workflow calls the bounded probe script. It does not exercise PR #264's FastAPI endpoint or PR #267's Workbench browser view.

measurement.trade_off: Retain only compact evidence and hashes. Do not commit raw light curves or expand into bulk DR24 acquisition.

evidence: Workflow run 41674952418 completed successfully and produced artifact 13251350175.
An independent run, 41674221225, produced identical epoch CSV and summary JSON SHA-256 values.
The artifact ZIP SHA-256 was recomputed as 8c17485d3b5ba651a997d5bc5ad5bca7528655685e8204fdf416af08176fccc7.
The epoch CSV SHA-256 was recomputed as c37f4d7ac4e294b14a3f2e87b9b35bacaf79a4baf02b30ab85df2984b1d29bbd.
The summary JSON SHA-256 was recomputed as 020f7febb47b3fd95720b383d6302254d88c6b2a54a8d080eef6375ebb989835.
All four requested OIDs were returned; total epoch count was 626; per-OID payload counts match catalog nepochs.
All 626 HMJD, mag, and magerr values are finite; all magerr values are positive.
catflags was retained without filtering: 570 rows have value 0 and 56 rows have value 32768.
No color correction, HMJD conversion, OID grouping, feature generation, or inference was performed.

unresolved: The probe does not exercise the FastAPI adapter introduced by PR #264.
The Workbench UI in PR #267 has not been tested against the live API.
The application-level 5-10 object smoke test and 30-50 object guided demonstration remain open.

findings: A bounded objectid-indexed query can retrieve raw DR24 epochs for the four tested OIDs.
The source payload includes objectid, filterid, fieldid, rcid, hmjd, mag, magerr, clrcoeff, and catflags.
Catalog nepochs is a useful per-OID integrity check for this probe.
Raw catflags must remain visible; bit-15 epochs must not be silently removed.
HMJD and native magnitude values must remain unchanged until separate, versioned scientific contracts are approved.

open_blockers: Complete the isolated repeat on PR #268 and compare all output hashes.
Exercise PR #264's FastAPI endpoint against the same OIDs and compare its raw response with the retained probe artifact.
Test PR #267's browser view for valid, missing, invalid, and source-failure cases.
Produce a 5-10 object application smoke-test manifest before expanding to the 30-50 object guided demonstration.

knowledge_carried_forward: Treat this report as verified raw-source acquisition evidence, not scientific validation.
Do not feed raw DR24 data to the frozen v0.2.0 model without a validated feature mapping.
Do not merge OIDs or infer physical-source identity from proximity alone.
Keep HMJD, mag, clrcoeff, and catflags source-native.
Keep Issue #253 open until the API, UI, and application smoke-test gates pass.
